Pixel's Internet tile for One UI 9: one quick-panel tile for Wi-Fi and mobile data.

- Stretch it to 2× wide to see the network: "Internet" over the Wi-Fi name, or the carrier and 4G/5G.
- Tap: Pixel's Wi-Fi toggle. It pauses Wi-Fi so mobile data takes over; tap again to search and reconnect.
- Long-press: internet panel with mobile data and Wi-Fi switches and nearby networks to join.

Needs Android 17 (One UI 9) and [Shizuku](https://shizuku.rikka.app/). Install the APK, open OneNet, allow Shizuku, then add the tile.
